scope: Semantic-preserving infrastructure change: six broker indicator calls replaced by local derivation from the single authoritative bar payload, over the same windows the broker calls requested. Full-420 converged semantics are deliberately NOT adopted.

baseline_production.role: what production was before this branch; six indicator calls

formula_equivalence_evidence.role: prior milestone; one shared long window, answering whether the formulas agree on identical inputs

cutover_parity_comparison.role: this milestone's evidence; each indicator at its OWN v3 production range, output widened only to expose more comparison points. Output width cannot change a value: the endpoint computes over the range first and trims after.
cutover_parity_comparison.only_deviation_from_v3: output widened from ['last:2', 'latest'] to last:30, purely to expose more comparison points; the endpoint computes over the range first and trims afterward, so it cannot change a value
cutover_parity_comparison.ranges_source: read programmatically from local-indicator-derivation rather than duplicated, so a moved window cannot leave this profile describing a run nobody made
cutover_parity_comparison.note: adjustment_type and start_time are not echoed by the endpoint, so they are attested from the pinned request rather than recovered from the response. A response proves what the provider computed, not the literal arguments sent.

candidate_production.role: four market-data calls; no indicator endpoint

local_derivation.role: how bars become indicators, and now the sole record of the legacy windows

completed_bar_policy.why_not_wall_clock: build_order_payload sends market_hours=regular_hours unconditionally, and the broker restricts fractional and dollar-denominated orders -- every order this account size can place -- to type=market in regular hours. An indicator advancing after the close could never inform an order placed that day, so clock sensitivity would buy nothing and would make derivation depend on when a cycle ran.
observations_2026_08_25: 08:45 ET (pre-market): newest bar and newest indicator point both the prior session
16:28 ET (28 min after close): both still the prior session
completed_bar_policy.not_observed: regular-hours behaviour; the in-progress bar case was never seen
completed_bar_policy.consequence: The rule is required rather than optional. The historicals guide states the newest close is not the settled one, and absence of a contrary observation is not evidence of absence on a path that feeds entries.
completed_bar_policy.boundary: an evening cycle excludes that day's now-final bar, which is what the broker endpoint was still doing 28 minutes after the close
completed_bar_policy.if_after_hours_is_ever_supported: needs a bounded post-close observation of when the endpoint advances -- not a guess

warm_up_finding.problem: Slicing the superset by timestamp reproduces the request boundary but not the values: the endpoint prepends warm-up before start_time so its first returned point lands AT the requested start. Literal-window RSI(14) on AAPL differed by 2.3e-03 points, 23x the tolerance the formula-equivalence milestone justified.
warm_up_finding.sma_exemption: A finite window's last value cannot be moved by bars before its span -- SMA20 matched at 5e-14 with no prepend. Declaring one for consistency made SMA200 unsatisfiable inside the 420-day envelope, needing 199 bars before a boundary only 62 bars from the payload start, which is how the exemption was found.
warm_up_finding.status_after_cutover: These are now OUR pinned semantics, not a live dependency. Production no longer calls the indicator endpoint, so a later change to Robinhood's warm-up policy cannot move a production value. They are empirical legacy-compatibility constants, not universal indicator mathematics.

numeric_parity.comparison: legacy-window local vs current production broker values

decision_parity.harness_note: Compared only where both sides carry every input; local SMA series are shorter because the provider prepends warm-up to fill its series, while a finite window needs none for its latest value. Production derives one latest value from the full envelope and is unaffected.

pipeline_parity.method: 144 measured broker/local value pairs from the parity run -- genuinely different numbers, 0 bitwise identical -- run through the real strategy, risk engine, critic and execution path from otherwise identical inputs (same non-indicator snapshot fields, AccountState, AppConfig, trading_date and now). An earlier version of this test copied local values into the broker side, which proved provenance invariance and nothing about parity; that test still exists, renamed for what it does.
contexts: held position / exit, with an active stop
synthetic boundaries: RSI 30, RSI 45, RSI 72, flat MACD histogram, price on SMA20, price on SMA200, ATR at the max-stop ceiling

reason_text_differences.cause: those strings format indicator values to two decimals, so a residual in the thirteenth decimal can round differently at a .xx5 edge -- e.g. SMA20 rendering as 14.31 against 14.30
reason_text_differences.decision_effect: none; every decision field matched on all 144 pairs
reason_text_differences.why_reported: no gate reads them, but the performance review does, so it is a real documented property rather than something to tolerate silently

call_reduction.not_counted: account-level calls (get_accounts, get_portfolio, positions, orders) are unchanged by this milestone

not_adopted.full_420_converged_semantics: Deliberately out of scope. The legacy windows are shorter than the convergence requirement (RSI needs ~203 bars, MACD ~277), so the current values carry seed dependence -- the same dependence today's production values carry. Reproducing it is what makes this cutover attributable. Adopting the converged values is a behaviour change for a separate milestone with its own boundary analysis.

execution_mode: shadow only; no execution mode enabled by this work

acceptance_claim.established: observed production parity over the sampled window
acceptance_claim.not_established: mathematical identity at every possible threshold value. Placed exactly astride a strict comparison and separated by the measured ~1e-13 residual, two implementations reach different conclusions -- that is arithmetic, not a defect. In the 144 measured pairs the closest RSI sat far more than 1e-6 from a band edge, so nothing came near enough for it to matter.

session_admission.enforced_by: build_order_payload, structurally, before the protection floor
session_admission.applies_to: BUY and SELL alike -- the protection floor guards entries only
session_admission.shadow: exempt; out-of-hours evaluation is how analysis and replay work
session_admission.calendar: explicit NYSE rules: weekends, nine fixed and floating holidays, Good Friday from Easter, Juneteenth from 2022, and the 13:00 early closes. No new dependency; the DST rule is written out because zoneinfo needs a tz database this platform does not ship.
session_admission.not_modelled: unscheduled closures (weather, days of mourning, circuit-breaker halts). Those make it more permissive than reality, never less, which is part of why live execution still requires human confirmation.
session_admission.determinism: derived from the given instant; a replay with the recorded now agrees forever
